p: Singleplayer is a game mode where one person plays alone, experiencing story-driven adventures, AI opponents, and personal challenges. Games like Skyrim and The Witcher offer deep solo experiences with exploration and freedom.
name: Singleplayer

p: Steam Achievements are rewards earned by players for completing challenges in games. They track progress, encourage exploration, and let players showcase accomplishments and compare milestones with friends.
name: Steam Achievements

p: Multiplayer is a game mode where multiple players interact online or locally, competing or cooperating in dynamic gameplay. It fosters teamwork, strategy, and social connection in games like Fortnite, Pubg and Counter-Strike.
name: Multiplayer

p: Full controller support means a game can be played entirely with a controller, without needing a keyboard or mouse. It ensures seamless gameplay on platforms like Steam and consoles.
name: Full controller support

p: Steam Cloud allows players to store game progress, settings, and saves online, enabling access across devices. It ensures data backup, preventing loss due to hardware failure or reinstallations.
name: Steam Cloud

p: Atmospheric games create immersive environments using detailed visuals, sound, and storytelling to evoke emotion and mood. They enhance player experience with deep ambiance, making worlds feel alive and engaging.
name: Atmospheric

p: Steam Trading Cards are virtual collectibles earned by playing Steam games. Players can trade, sell, or craft them into badges, unlocking profile rewards like backgrounds, emoticons, and XP.
name: steam-trading-cards

p: A great soundtrack enhances a game's atmosphere, evoking emotion and immersion. Memorable music complements gameplay, heightening tension, excitement, or nostalgia in titles like Celeste or The Witcher 3
name: Great Soundtrack

p: RPG (Role-Playing Game) lets players control characters, make story-driven choices, and develop skills. Games like Elden Ring and The Witcher 3 offer deep narratives and exploration.
name: RPG

p: Co-op (cooperative gameplay) lets players work together in a shared game experience, completing objectives, solving challenges, or battling enemies. Games like Minecraft and It Takes Two emphasize teamwork.
name: Co-op
